run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-15T09:01:18Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is explained by 5xx responses on a single route: frontend-proxy returned 500 'via_upstream' for POST /api/checkout starting 2026-11-15T09:01:30Z while its other routes (POST /api/cart, GET /api/products/*, GET /api/data, GET /api/recommendations) kept returning 200/308 in the same seconds. The failure traces one hop back to the checkout service: the checkout Deployment was rolled out at 09:01:25Z (generation 4) with a container image reference that contains an embedded newline, "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0"; the kubelet rejects it with InvalidImageName, the only checkout pod (checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68) is Pending with the container waiting in InvalidImageName and 0 restarts, and the checkout Service has no ready endpoint addresses. frontend's error spans are exactly POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and the client span grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, and checkout stopped emitting spans entirely from ~09:08. frontend-proxy itself is unchanged (deployment generation 1, 1 available replica) and its non-checkout routes succeed, so the proxy is reporting upstream checkout failures rather than originating errors. The first 500 observed (09:01:30Z) is 12 s after the alert's stated start (09:01:18Z); that small discrepancy is unresolved but no other error source of comparable magnitude was found in the window.

claims.text: frontend-proxy span error rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total, status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) was ~0 to 0.004/s from 08:42:18Z to ~08:59Z, then rose sharply from the 09:03:18Z sample, peaking at 0.748/s (span_name="ingress") and 0.748/s (span_name="router frontend egress") around 09:09:18Z and still 0.217/s at the 09:15:18Z sample.

Among all services with ERROR-status spans, frontend and frontend-proxy are the only ones that rose: frontend reached 2.88 errors/s (09:10:18Z sample) and frontend-proxy 1.41/s; accounting, cart, payment were flat 0, and ad (0.0037/s), recommendation (~0.0037/s) and fraud-detection (0.0038/s) stayed at single-span-per-5-minute noise level both before and during the burst.

Within frontend, the only operations with ERROR spans after 09:02 are POST /api/checkout, 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout', grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (client span) and POST — all zero until the 09:04:18Z sample, peaking at 0.7148/s at the 09:10:18Z sample — while GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, grpc.oteldemo.CartService/* and grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds stayed at 0 errors.

frontend-proxy's own access logs show the failing request type: the first 500 in the burst is "POST /api/checkout HTTP/1.1" 500 - via_upstream at 2026-11-15T09:01:30.493784Z, followed by a continuous stream of identical POST /api/checkout 500 lines (09:01:32Z, 09:01:35Z, 09:01:36Z, 09:01:38Z, 09:01:54Z, 09:01:58Z, ...); in the same period GET /api/cart, GET /api/products/*, GET /api/recommendations and GET /api/data returned 200/308.

Kubernetes events in otel-demo show a checkout rollout at 09:01:25Z–09:01:35Z: ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 was created (SuccessfulCreate), the old pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-xq5bq was deleted (SuccessfulDelete, container 'checkout' stopped at 09:01:28Z), Deployment checkout scaled checkout-d75b77f99 from 0 to 1, and the new pods failed with Warning InspectFailed / Warning Failed: "Failed to apply default image tag \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0\": couldn't parse image name ... invalid reference format" / "Error: InvalidImageName".

Deployment otel-demo/checkout is at generation 4, spec.template container image is exactly "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0" (embedded newline before the tag), status reports unavailableReplicas=1, availableReplicas and readyReplicas null, and condition Available=False with reason MinimumReplicasUnavailable ("Deployment does not have minimum availability."); init container image is busybox:latest.

Pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (owner ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99) is phase Pending, Ready=False (ContainersNotReady) with restartCount 0; its 'checkout' container is in state waiting reason InvalidImageName with message "Failed to apply default image tag \"quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0\": couldn't parse image name ... invalid reference format", while init container wait-for-kafka completed with exit code 0 at 09:01:36Z and the pod is PodScheduled=True.

Ownership chain: ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb (created 08:23:20Z, owned by Deployment checkout, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, replicas 0) was replaced by ReplicaSet checkout-d75b77f99 (created 09:01:25Z, owned by Deployment checkout, malformed image, replicas 1, readyReplicas null).
The checkout Service has no ready backends: endpoints 'checkout' contains only notReadyAddresses for pod checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 (port tcp-service 8080), no ready addresses.

checkout's span throughput collapsed: rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total) for span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder fell from 0.70/s (09:02:18Z) to 0.374/s (09:04:18Z), 0.137/s (09:06:18Z) and 0 for every sample from 09:08:18Z on; the same pattern appears for oteldemo.CartService/GetCart, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, shipping (/get-quote, /ship-order) and email (POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email), all 0 from 09:08:18Z.

Only the checkout Deployment is degraded in otel-demo: of 21 deployments, checkout is the sole one with availableReplicas null / unavailableReplicas 1 and the sole one whose container image is not a ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-* style reference; frontend (gen 1), frontend-proxy (gen 1), cart, payment, shipping, email, currency and the rest all report availableReplicas=1 with their normal images.

Deepest supported cause: the checkout Deployment change rolled out at ~09:01:25Z replaced the working image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with the malformed reference "quay.io/it-bench/hello-bench-arm64\n:1.0.0"; the kubelet cannot start the container (InvalidImageName), checkout has zero ready endpoints, frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls from POST /api/checkout fail, frontend answers 500, frontend-proxy logs and traces those as 'via_upstream' 5xx, which is the error-rate signal behind the frontend-proxy RequestErrorRate alert. Mechanism is fully evidenced; the chain rests on the observed timing (500s start 2 s after the old checkout pod was stopped) and is not proven by a per-request trace, because no incident-window traces are retrievable.

frontend-proxy as the origin of the errors was considered and rejected: its Deployment is generation 1 with 1 available replica, its pod frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-t9gll has restartCount 0, and its logs show 200/308 responses for /api/cart, /api/products/*, /api/recommendations and /api/data in the same seconds as the POST /api/checkout 500s, so the proxy's error signal is a reflection of its frontend/checkout upstream.

The sporadic frontend-proxy 503 'UC upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination}' lines (08:49:55Z, 08:50:09Z, 09:00:12Z on /api/cart, /api/recommendations and /api/products/*) were considered as the alert trigger and rejected: they are isolated, affect different routes, predate the burst, and correspond to the low baseline error rate (~0.004–0.018/s) rather than the sustained 0.6–0.75/s POST /api/checkout 500 burst.

checkout's own span statuses do not show ERROR: every checkout span series in the window is STATUS_CODE_UNSET (HTTP POST, orders publish, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, oteldemo.CartService/*, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct), which is consistent with the traffic simply stopping rather than checkout reporting application errors — checkout's own failure is a container that never started, observed only via Kubernetes state and events.

Correct the checkout Deployment's container image reference so it is a valid reference with no embedded newline (the previous working value was ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout), let the rollout create a Ready pod, and verify the checkout Service gains ready endpoint addresses; then confirm frontend's POST /api/checkout stops returning 500 and frontend-proxy's error-rate signal returns to baseline.

gaps: The RequestErrorRate alerting rule is not present in Prometheus (list_prometheus_rules with rule_name=RequestErrorRate returned no_data), so the alert's exact expression and its reported value 2.0444 cannot be verified against the metrics I could query.

Jaeger returned trace data only up to ~2026-11-15T08:49:21Z (traces_search for frontend and traces_search_by_tags error=true on frontend/frontend-proxy returned no_data for 09:00–09:15), so no incident-window span (and no per-span error detail for grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) could be inspected; trace conclusions here rest on Prometheus span metrics, not on trace graphs.
The frontend pod's stdout returned zero readable lines for 09:00–09:15Z (container frontend, no previous instance), so frontend's own error text for the failed PlaceOrder call is unknown.

No kube-state-metrics series (kube_deployment_status_*, kube_pod_owner, kube_replicaset_owner) exist in this Prometheus, so deployment/pod availability could not be charted over time; the Deployment/ReplicaSet/Pod objects I cite are the state at ~09:23Z, about a minute after the authorized window end, and Events are the only historical record of the 09:01 rollout.

The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what changed the checkout Deployment image (and whether a trailing newline was introduced by a script, copy/paste or templating error) cannot be determined.

The alert's stated start 2026-11-15T09:01:18Z precedes the first observable 500 (09:01:30.49Z) and the old checkout pod's termination (09:01:28Z) by ~10–12 s; the reason for that offset (alert evaluation/anchor timing) is unresolved.

frontend-proxy ingress request rate (STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans) declined from ~12.6/s at 09:10:18Z to ~3.3/s at 09:15:18Z and the error rate also decayed after 09:09; whether this reflects load-generator behaviour or back-pressure from the failing checkout path was not determined.
I did not check checkout-d75b77f99-hgc68 application logs (the checkout container never started, so no application log instance exists to read) beyond its container waiting state and Events.
next_steps: Fix the otel-demo/checkout Deployment image value to a valid reference without the embedded newline (previous working image: ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout) and roll it out deliberately.

After the fix, verify checkout pod readiness, readiness of the checkout Service endpoints, frontend POST /api/checkout returning 200, and frontend-proxy ingress error spans returning to the pre-09:00 baseline.

Retrieve the change record for the checkout Deployment around 2026-11-15T09:01:25Z (change_history integration) to identify the source of the malformed image string and prevent recurrence, e.g. validate image references in the deployment pipeline.
If a precise alert-expression check is needed, load or inspect the RequestErrorRate rule definition outside this Prometheus, since the rule is not present in the queried instance.
